summary_en: This Phase 1b study tests relugolix and enzalutamide, two oral medicines, given before and after radiation therapy or surgery in men with high-risk locally advanced prostate cancer. Relugolix is taken once daily with a 360 mg loading dose on day 1, and enzalutamide is taken once daily. The plan is 6 months of hormone therapy before treatment, hormone therapy during radiation, and then 18 more months of maintenance hormone therapy. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; its stated questions ask whether the combination helps increase the chance of cure and whether patients live longer without the cancer getting worse.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1b evalúa relugolix y enzalutamida, dos medicamentos orales, administrados antes y después de la radioterapia o la cirugía en hombres con cáncer de próstata localmente avanzado de alto riesgo. El relugolix se toma una vez al día con una dosis de carga de 360 mg el día 1, y la enzalutamida también se toma una vez al día. El plan incluye 6 meses de terapia hormonal antes del tratamiento, terapia hormonal durante la radioterapia y luego 18 meses adicionales de terapia hormonal de mantenimiento. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; sus preguntas planteadas son si la combinación ayuda a aumentar la probabilidad de curación y si los pacientes viven más tiempo sin que el cáncer empeore.
who_for: Men 18 years or older with prostate adenocarcinoma confirmed by pathology
Locally advanced high-risk disease, defined by PSA, grade, or clinical stage criteria
Life expectancy of at least 6 months in the investigator's opinion
Normal organ and bone marrow function at screening, and willingness to use contraception
not_for: Major heart event, new heart failure, or stroke within the past 6 months
Not a candidate for surgery or radiation therapy
